title: Scanning a Word by Fixed-Width Blocks
statement: Let $N$ be a finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols, let $u$ be a finite Boolean word, and let $m\in\mathbb N$ satisfy $|u|=Wm$, where $W$ is the block width associated to $N$. Scanning $u$ produces the verifier state obtained by starting at the initial state and successively applying the option-valued verifier step to the decoded blocks $(u[Wj:W(j+1)])$ for $j=0,\ldots,m-1$.
hypotheses_covered: A finite nondeterministic Turing machine with Boolean tape symbols
